reason.macFull: The device MAC is in the interception list
reason.hostFull: The device address is in the interception list
reason.subnetFull: The device is in the {{subnet}} subnet from the interception list. Turning it off excludes it from the subnet.
reason.excludedFull: The device is in the {{subnet}} subnet from the interception list but excluded from it, so it goes direct.

dialog.description: sing-box restarts and all devices lose their connections. Then confirm the connection works, or everything reverts when the countdown ends.

bar.label: Interception change
bar.prompt: Interception changed. Confirm the connection works,
bar.rollback: otherwise the daemon restores the previous one

failure.rolledBack: No confirmation came: the previous setting is back
failure.failed: The interception change did not go through

reason.backup_failed: the snapshot of the previous interception settings was not saved, so the daemon did not change them without a way back
reason.write_failed: the interception settings were not written to UCI
reason.restart_failed: the service did not restart with the new interception settings
reason.healthcheck_failed: the service came up, but sing-box did not respond
reason.dns_probe_failed: sing-box did not answer a DNS query through dns-in on the port from the interception settings
reason.interception_missing: after the restart the nft interception rules are not in place
reason.rollback_failed: the previous interception settings could not be restored — the new ones stayed on the device
reason.no_backup: there was nothing to roll back to: the device had no previous interception settings
reason.lists_restored: only the rule-set files were restored: the device had no previous config

subnets.title: Addresses and subnets through sing-box
subnets.description: Every device whose address falls into the list goes through sing-box: 192.168.1.20 is one device, 192.168.1.0/24 the whole 192.168.1.x range. A device inside a subnet is excluded with its toggle below.
subnets.forAll: Interception for everyone is on: the list takes effect only when interception is limited to listed devices.
subnets.hint: Enter, a comma or a space adds an entry. To change one, remove it and type it again.

error.invalid: “{{value}}” is not an IPv4 address or subnet. Write it like 192.168.1.20 or 192.168.1.0/24.
error.hostBits: {{value}} does not start the subnet: write {{subnet}}.

subnets.dialog: Apply the new list of addresses and subnets?
